articles.headline: Giants expect Nabers, Thomas, Skattebo and Likely to play Sunday
articles.summary: New York Giants wide receiver Malik Nabers is expected to play Sunday against the Washington Commanders after missing a practice earlier in the week because of knee soreness.

articles.headline: Commanders QB Daniels will play, WR Diggs out against Giants
articles.summary: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels will start Sunday in his return from an elbow injury, but wide receiver Stefon Diggs will not play against the Giants due to a hamstring injury.
